brand_notes: Debut Reference line (Andrew Jones design), /pair, 6 ohm 2-way. Elac support: one owner reports no reply after a tweeter failure (users-elac-debut-reference-dbr-62). Elac site not scriptable; retailer-reproduced specs used. Black/walnut finish out of stock at World Wide Stereo.
takeaways: EAC Klippel: LW ±1.3 dB, f3 52 Hz, sens 83.9 dB, pref 5.1/7.3; ASR unit LW ±2.1 dB, sens 85.3
Min impedance 5.2 Ω (EAC) and 5 Ω (ASR), above IEC floor; EPDR 2.4 Ω, phase about -60 deg near 100 Hz
THD graph-read about 1.3% at 86 dB and 2.2% at 96 dB
What Hi-Fi? 4/5: transparent midrange, subdued punch
